description: Proration and day-count fractions (30/360, ACT/365F, ACT/360, ACT/ACT ISDA) on half-open date ranges — Computes the year fraction of up to 100 half-open date ranges [start, end) under a named ISDA day-count convention, and optionally the prorated charge, for an agent billing a partial period or accruing interest. Conventions follow Section 4.16 of the 2006 ISDA Definitions: 30/360, 30E/360, 30E/360 (ISDA), Actual/365 (Fixed), Actual/360, Actual/Actual (ISDA), 1/1. `end` is the day immediately follo

amount.description: Optional amount to prorate (annual amount without `period`; period amount with it).

end.description: Exclusive end: the day after the last day included. Must not precede start.

period.description: Full billing period [start, end); the charge is amount x fraction(range) / fraction(period).

rounding.description: Rounding of the charge to the currency's minor unit. Default half-up. half-up: ties away from zero. half-down: ties toward zero. half-even: ties to the even neighbour. up: away from zero. down: toward zero. ceiling: toward +infinity. floor: toward -infinity.

terminationDate.description: Termination date of the transaction; only used by 30E/360-ISDA.

name: proration
